description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
